title: Public Employees' Retirement Association (Colorado Revised Statutes, Title 24, Article 51)
verified_how: Expanded the official CRS Annotated table of contents: 'Title 24. Government - State (ss 24-1-101 - 24-118-101)' > 'Public Employees' Retirement Systems (Arts. 51 - 54.8)' > 'Article 51. Public Employees' Retirement Association (Pts. 1 - 17)', listed live with Article 51.1 Pension Review Commission, Article 52 Deferred Compensation Plan, Article 53 Public Employees' Social Security and Article 54.3 Colorado Secure Savings Program Act.
notes: Public employees only (Colorado PERA). Private pensions (ERISA) and Social Security are federal; Article 53 is the state's machinery for Social Security coverage of public employees, and Article 54.3 is the state-facilitated private-sector retirement savings programme.
